note: Words the game teaches that no local OpenJLPT file contains. Authored by the project, marked source:project so they are never mistaken for sourced data. reviewed is false until a native reviewer is named.

examples.ja: 今夜の夕食の配膳を引き受けていただけませんか。
examples.en: Would you be willing to undertake serving tonight's dinner?

items.note: Absent from every local OpenJLPT file. Core Inn target.

examples.ja: お茶をコンロでもう一度温めてください。
examples.en: Please warm the tea on the stove once more.

items.note: The source has 暖める (air, rooms) but not 温める (food, drink). Keeping only 暖める would reintroduce a Japanese error this project already fixed.

examples.ja: 古いタオルを新しいタオルに取り替えてください。
examples.en: Please replace the old towel with a new one.

items.note: Present in the local files only as N4. Held here as the idiomatic alternative to 代える for swapping an object, pending native review.
